title: MLLMs Know When Before Speaking: Revealing and Recovering Temporal Grounding via Attention Cues

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: MLLMs Know When Before Speaking: Revealing and Recovering Temporal Grounding via Attention Cues Video temporal grounding (VTG), which localizes the start and end times of a queried event in an untrimmed video, is a key test of whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) understand not only what happens but also when it happens.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: This intervention evidence suggests that MLLMs do contain an internal temporal localization mechanism, but that it is concentrated in a sparse set of heads rather than distributed uniformly across the network.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: In this work, we probe the cross-modal attention of MLLMs and uncover a perception-generation gap.
